title: GET Request 📥
ques: Use the **Requests** library to make a GET request to `https://api.github.com`.
explanation: **`requests.get()`** sends a GET request. The response object `r` contains all the data from the server.

title: JSON Response 📦
ques: How do you extract the **JSON content** from a response object `r`?
explanation: The **`json()`** method decodes the JSON response into a Python dictionary or list.

title: Status Codes 🚦
ques: Check if a request was successful (status code 200).
explanation: The **`status_code`** attribute holds the HTTP status code returned by the server.
